messages:
mira: quick postmortem follow-up — last night's alert flood showed recurring signal patterns. want clear owners and minimal timelines for pruning/noise work: 
- consolidate duplicate error alerts (owner: tom) target: 5d
- raise noisy infra thresholds + 24h staging dry-run (owner: lee) target: 72h
- add suppression for short-lived flappers and route suppressed -> #suppression-review (owner: selena) target: 10d
Please ack and call out blockers; tagging @ops-bot to create a tracker.

tom: acked. i'll take dedupe. plan: merge alert-template change to use `job:error_sig` dedupe key, exceptions for user-scoped errors. PR by Wed.

lee: i can do thresholds. i'll bump CPU rule and run a 24h staging dry-run, then monitor. will post grafana link after dry-run.

selena: suppression prototype ok. idea: suppress when flap_count > 4 within 15m and emit a suppressed metric. need list of control-plane hosts to exclude.

ops-bot: Task created: https://tasks.company/INFR-9002 "Alert signal pruning & suppression" assigned to [tom, lee, selena] due 2026-06-10 :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in 7d (1867606634).

mira: answers: tom -> yes to job:error_sig and user exceptions; selena -> exclude control-plane, i'll DM list. if anyone needs a longer timeline, say now. otherwise i'll add these to the postmortem action table and close the ticket when smoke tests pass. :thumbsup:
